title: Keynote: The Road To LiveView 1.0 by Chris McCord | ElixirConf EU 2023
summary: Chris McCord's ElixirConf EU 2023 keynote tracing LiveView's evolution from simple form validation to full apps, with code examples and live demos of what 1.0 will offer.
why: Referenced as a demo of how easily Phoenix LiveView handles things like bidirectional infinite pagination with streams.

quote.text: shows how easy it is to do bidirectional infinite pagination
